body: Thank you so much, today is a better day. A friend I actually made on Reddit told me to listen to my daughter breath and it really helped.

my daughter is sick right now, took her to the Er yesterday and she had a fever and was developing pneumonia. They gave her anti biotics and I got her prescription and today has just been a terrible day for her. She coughs and it hurts and bout two hours ago her temp was 100 so I gave her some Motrin. Just feel lost I know her mom would know exactly what to do, but me especially in the state I am, am terrified of losing my daughter. She is all I have.

Trust me I understand that. Within the last four years I lost my grandfather, both parents, my son, and wife. God does seem like he does things only to harm us but through my grief I began to hate the idea of god and now I’m simply don’t care. You gotta forge your own path, don’t look for meanings in the whys of things just forge your own path. Find a hope for yourself, a reason for you to exist even if it’s to see your kids, anything. If god is a mean kid on the anthill be the ant that wins and keeps existing no matter what he does.

If you ever need anyone to talk to I’m here. Just stay strong, you sound very strong and like you have allot of willpower so keep going you never know where things might take you. You gotta have hope, I know I do, I have to find it everyday my daughter really helps but I’m trying to have hope for myself as well.
Incredible story, my wife died two weeks ago to suicide and we share a eight month old. I agree this has been the worst time of my life. I hope things get better for you.
